The Union Health Ministry has proposed expanding the network of authorised import gateways for drugs, medical devices and cosmetics by adding several inland container depots, a special economic zone and an international airport to facilitate faster clearance and improve supply chain efficiency.

articles.title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump admin's push to set aside California ballots
articles.summary:
The Supreme Court on Monday rejected a push for California to set aside thousands of mail ballots from people President Donald Trump's administration claims are noncitizens, a decision that comes on the eve of the pivotal midterm elections.
The high court refused to intervene in a case involving 20,000 people the Republican administration flagged as likely noncitizens on the largely Democratic state's voter rolls.
It was the latest in a flurry of election-related litigation the day before the midterm elections, which will decide control of Congress for the last two years of Trump's second term.
In California, the Trump administration had asked the high court to set aside the challenged ballots until the voters' citizenship status could be verified. But officials there said that the list appeared to be filled with errors and that setting the ballots aside could effectively disenfranchise legal voters.
The high court did not detail its reasoning, as is common in emergency decisions.

articles.title: Oil slide hands India's 10-year bond its best day since early April
articles.summary: The recent drop in Brent crude prices is creating an uptick in demand for Indian government bonds, particularly shining on the 10-year note which has experienced its strongest performance since April. As yields decrease, investors are keen to secure these advantageous rates ahead of the US midterm elections, aware of their potential market implications.
